# SkillBox

> SkillBox is a free native macOS app by independent developer Tao for organizing local AI Skill files (SKILL.md). This is the product's public website. App Store ID: 6828314753.

## Product facts
- Platform: macOS 14 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel. No iOS, iPadOS or Windows app.
- Free download. Local organization requires no SkillBox account or AI API key.
- Scan folders authorized through macOS; read instructions and files; search, categorize, tag, favorite, write notes and mark My Creations.
- Compare installation environments; distinguish missing access from missing files and content differences; review changes before applying.
- Complete manual migration can include selected Skill files and organization. Organization-only export does not include files. No automatic cloud sync.
- Does not execute Skill scripts or run AI models. Does not upload local files, paths, notes or library contents to the developer.
- Optional public GitHub source checks are user-initiated network requests. GitHub receives normal connection information, such as IP addresses.
- Third-party tool names describe local environments, not affiliation or guaranteed execution compatibility.

- [Privacy policy](https://sxt417.github.io/skillbox-support/privacy.html): Local processing, permission bookmarks, exports and optional network requests.
- [English product and press](https://sxt417.github.io/skillbox-support/press.html): Product story and original screenshots.
- [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6828314753): Authoritative download and currently available version. A newer version being prepared or reviewed is not yet available.
